name: title-attract
description: Cold boot to the title screen and attract loop (no savestate; the attract demo cycles on its own after the title timeout). For title/menu-family units (chunk 0013, research/decomp/index/title-main-menu-flow.md). Cold boot needs minutes before gameplay-relevant code fires (README fact 6) -- use generous --max-seconds and expect menu/attract code only.
live_families_basis: UNKNOWN, deliberately. Cold boot reaches the title screen and then an attract/demo loop; nobody has measured which borg families the attract demo constructs, and it plainly does show battle footage. Declaring [] here would claim a measurement that does not exist and would skip every family-gated unit routed to this scenario. null keeps the family gate OFF for title-attract (pre-gate behaviour) until someone measures the attract roster.
